explanation-reproducibility.quote: Instructor-created synthetic example, authored but not executed. Each row describes one fictional country and year. The reshape keeps all nine source cells, including three missing values. Independent scalar lookups compare each country/year pair with its original source cell; additional checks cover duplicate keys, row count, missingness and preservation of the input. CSV output excludes the row index.
